## [1.41.0](https://github.com/PerfLite/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.41.0) (2026-09-08)

### ⚡ Upstream 1.41.0 Sync & Features

* **Upstream 1.41.0 updates merged:** Support for YouTube 21.35.442 / 21.07.247, YouTube Music 9.34.52, Reddit 2026.35.0.
* **New upstream patches:** App refresh rate, PoToken provider, Fullscreen video scale, Mute button, Player volume ducking/muting hooks, Feature flags manager binary search.
* **Voice-Over Translation (VOT):** Full Yandex neural voice dubbing with Lively Voice (Живой голос), automatic language detection, volume ducking, and rate-limiting protections.
